verdict.rationale: Formant's own marketing documents automated incident detection and dispatching help when something looks wrong, plus peer-to-peer teleoperation for operators and recorded interventions. Together these approximate routing failures to a human who takes control, but the docs never describe a dedicated intervention queue or a hand-back-to-autonomy step. Missing for 10: an explicit operator intervention queue, a documented resolve/hand-back-control workflow, first-party technical docs beyond marketing pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can route autonomy failures to a human intervention queue where an operator resolves and hands back control
